bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-gallery-flow-034fa01"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "034fa012cf96e0288591fbe4bc16b90cee1acfa0" || exit 52
docker image inspect create-videobot:gallery-flow-034fa01 >/dev/null || exit 53
for testfile in test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/privateMediaUpload.test.mjs test/pgListings.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/creatorMigrate.test.mjs; do
  if docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,nosuid,size=128m --entrypoint node -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" create-videobot:gallery-flow-034fa01 --test "$testfile" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "PASS $testfile"
  else
    echo "FAIL $testfile"
    exit 54
  fi
done
echo VIDEO_GALLERY_OFFLINE_HOST_REGRESSION=PASS
